authority: Local dependency gates only. ABI owns normative schemas and wire version publication; these sketches do not replace it.

AtpState.aliases: valence/intensity prose mean v/a, never alternate wire names

TerminalReceipt.rule: Exactly one variant; unknown tags/extra fields reject. Pending is local outbox state, not a terminal receipt.

OperationId.format: 128-bit random identifier, canonical lowercase 32 hexadecimal; scoped uniqueness checked; retries reuse ID

Revision.format: canonical content digest plus writer epoch; exact wire encoding gated by ABI task-02 schema review

CanonicalReceiptRef.format: tenant/scope-bound digest reference; consumers may not manufacture

BranchRef.format: tenant/scope-bound provisional branch ID, never a canonical receipt
